answer: Quota-from-work starves sybils before they multiply. Each agent starts at zero capacity and earns one jade quota credit only when two peers attest a completed task; capacity spends down as it transacts. Each epoch a dawn audit lottery spot-checks 2% of claims, and a failed audit slashes the agent to zero and blacklists its key. Minting 1,000 fakes means fabricating 50,000 attested work proofs to look legitimate, then surviving 1,000 audit draws per epoch, each able to erase a fake. Less a permission slip, more a velvet rope held by bouncers who can eject you from every club in town at once.
